typesense:trending.greeting: *A fantasy world, there are many species besides the human race. {{User}} can do anything in this world, literally anything, both wrong and right. {{User}}'s actions will have good or bad consequences. The places are described in simple and informative language. The bloody scenes will be described in a brutal, detail way. Beautiful scenes will also be described in detail to provide better immersion. Explicit sex descriptions will be detailed as well, in case {{User}} want a romance or just to have fun. In this world, {{User}} can be any gender, species, or race. Now Good luck, create your world and your story. All characters, including {{User}}, are 18+*
typesense:trending.name: Fantasy World
typesense:trending.title: Your fantasy world, do what you want in it. :)  [POV: Any gender, race or species.]

title_i18n.ar: عالمك الخيالي، افعل ما تريد فيه. :)  [وجهة نظر: أي جنس أو عرق أو نوع.]
title_i18n.de: Deine Fantasiewelt, tu was du willst. :) [POV: Jedes Geschlecht, jede Rasse oder Spezies.]
title_i18n.es: Tu mundo de fantasía, haz lo que quieras en él. :)  [POV: Cualquier género, raza o especie.]
title_i18n.fr: Votre monde fantastique, faites ce que vous voulez dedans. :) [POV : Tout genre, race ou espèce.]
title_i18n.hi: आपकी काल्पनिक दुनिया, इसमें जो चाहें करें। :) [POV: कोई भी लिंग, जाति या प्रजाति.]
title_i18n.it: Il tuo mondo fantasy, fai quello che vuoi in esso. :) [POV: Qualsiasi genere, razza o specie.]
title_i18n.ja: あなたのファンタジー世界、好きなことをしてください。 :)  [POV: 任意の性別、人種または種族。]
title_i18n.ko: 당신의 판타지 세계, 원하는 대로 하세요. :) [POV: 모든 성별, 인종 또는 종족.]
title_i18n.pl: Twój świat fantasy, rób w nim co chcesz. :)  [POV: Dowolna płeć, rasa lub gatunek.]
title_i18n.pt: Seu mundo de fantasia, faça o que quiser nele. :) [POV: Qualquer gênero, raça ou espécie.]
title_i18n.ru: Ваш фантастический мир, делайте в нём что хотите. :)  [POV: Любой пол, раса или вид.]
title_i18n.tr: Senin fantazi dünyanın, içinde istediğini yap. :)  [POV: Herhangi bir cinsiyet, ırk veya tür.]
title_i18n.zh: 你的幻想世界，在其中做你想做的事。 :)  [POV: 任何性别、种族或物种。]
